title: Why You Stay Alive (compiled)

voice.text: "So when you're initiated, the Guru would keep a certain amount of karma he wouldn't remove, it's called Prarabda, this karma which is on the way of working itself out."
"By accretion. And he would also accept that some people may not develop that far. So he made a distinction between those who would get liberation after you die and those who now."

"There are many features that distinguish the two, you know, the Siddhanta current and the Bhairava Tantras. One of them is that the male is very dominant in the Siddhanta current. Female beings, like, very few. Ten percent. Minor."
"With each Sao you repeat, you're blessing the world, you're bringing goodness into the world."
"what is that? You can't say anything more than it's just, there can be nothing higher. You're not actually saying what it is."

"He's called Shiva. Why? Because he's extremely tranquil... Because he's the cause of the cessation of that state... in which everything of a kind of universal agency... when he is the cause of bringing that to an end... then this universe also comes to a halt."

"Because he cannot be measured. He is Ananta... And because he is Aja. He is not born... Universe, 14 point whatever billion light years... someday it will end... Brahma and Indra and Vishnu... have a beginning... some other Brahma will take his place... But he has no beginning."

claims.text: rāgatattvaṃ tu karmāvacchinno 'bhilāṣaḥ — passion-principle is action-bounded longing.
karma tu tatra karmamātraṃ buddhidharmas tu rāgaḥ — action is mere action there; mind-nature is passion.
karmabhedacitra iti vibhāgo vakṣyate — varied by action-difference; distinction to be told.
Action mere; passion mind-nature; distinction deferred.
sa ca malo vijñānakevale vidyamāno dhvaṃsonmukha iti na svakāryaṃ karma āpyāyati — existing in knowledge-kevalin, facing destruction: does not fatten its effect-action.

pralayakevalasya tu jṛmbhamāṇa eva āsta iti malopodbalitaṃ karma saṃsāravaicitryabhoge nimittam — but yawning in dissolution-kevalin: impurity-strengthened action causes transmigration-variety-enjoyment.
Knowledge-kevalin starves action; dissolution-kevalin fuels it.
